verdict.rationale: The evidence shows request-driven agent capabilities: Agent API runs with built-in tools, a code sandbox, multi-step Pro Search, and delegating multi-step work to Computer through MCP. None of it documents a way to set up automations that run on their own in the background, such as schedules, triggers, recurring tasks, or detached background jobs. These are developer building blocks a user would have to orchestrate externally, so they earn no credit for this story.
